status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-bolt-crate, in Chapters VII, VIII, IX and X (the desktop app only)
use: The bolt-thrower's ammunition: a crate of bolts beside the carroballista beyond the board's west edge, in the field battles.

generator.prompt: A Roman ammunition crate for bolt-shooting engines: a sturdy open wooden box with rope handles, about one metre long and fifty centimetres wide, filled with bundles of iron-tipped wooden bolts tied with cord, lying lengthwise, and two more tied bundles of bolts lying on the ground beside it; about fifty-five centimetres high. Weathered wood, iron points and hemp cord. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.
